profile.text: Zuo Le, a 'Candleholder' of the Sui Regulator, the secret agency handling Yan's Feranmut problem. Currently stationed at Rhodes Island on supervisory duty, he regularly reports back to Yan. Sometimes participates in missions for Rhodes Island as a part-time field operator.
